title: The Sealed Finding
subtitle: Faithful-modern homage — original prose
source: Philip K. Dick, 'The Minority Report' (1956) — arcs/engine in canon/SOURCE_NOTES.md (arc ledger A-01..A-22)
mandates: #1 Inference, not prophecy — no precognition, ever
#2 The named are people — bodies, Tuesdays, one wrong-sized detail
#3 Both truths, always — the machine is a horror AND it works

cast.Josiah Motaung: Director, founder, 61 — named by his own instrument; reads competence as threat
cast.Ayesha Cassim: Deputy Director, 34 — loyal throughout; the red herring that never fires
cast.Miriam Motaung: Registrar of Findings, 57 — has copied 409 sealed findings since 2043
cast.Cornelius Grobler: Federation chairman, 68 — his case is correct, his motive is money
cast.Dries Lombard: W/O internal security, 49 — on the Federation payroll since 2051
cast.Grace Sithole: Reader A, 52 — filed Finding A; certain, because certainty cannot be checked
cast.Wynand Loots: Reader B, 41 — filed Finding B (sealed); his first dissent in fourteen months
cast.Karabo Ntuli: Reader C, 26 — filed Finding C and appended the Note; works out the recursion

chapters.title: Prologue
chapters.pov: close-third on an uptake team / the named man
chapters.setting: A flat in Kempton Park, 05:40, and the N12 afterwards
beats: An uptake start to finish: two officers, no weapon drawn, the printed card read aloud
Twenty minutes to pack; a call permitted; the neighbour on the landing
The named man has done nothing and is entirely ordinary (PP-014)
Paragraph four, quoted by an officer with pride, in a car, over breakfast (PP-001)
chapters.turn: It is courteous, lawful, and irreversible; nobody will ever know whether it was right

chapters.title: Struben Street
beats: The Director's ordinary morning; the building, the lift, the numbers he is proud of
The drawer: the Ngobese docket, 2027, never mentioned to anyone (PP-008)
Cassim, eleven weeks in, competent, and read as a knife (A-01, A-02)
The packet arrives; his own name; ANTICIPATED VICTIM: GROBLER, CORNELIUS JOHANNES
PRIOR CONTACT: None of record — the most damning line on the page (A-03, A-04, PP-003)
chapters.turn: He reads it as data for four seconds before he reads it as his life

chapters.title: Standing Items
chapters.setting: Executive meeting room; the registry corridor
beats: He goes to the standing meeting because not going would be a fact about him
Cassim asks, politely, in front of staff, for a March review of s.14(6) — and he grants it (PP-004)
The Federation's founding affidavit: sealed findings are unconstitutional; Grobler's signature on all of it
Lesego reads the diary: the congress, Monday the 9th, a standing security note (PP-011)
'the sealed findings from 2049 going to long store' — said mid-list, thinking about lunch (PP-010, PP-007 whisper)
After: the record says Provisional — 1 of 3. Suite B refreshes at 08:00, Suite C at 12:30
chapters.turn: The machine has not finished making up its mind about him, and he knows its schedule

chapters.title: Verification
beats: The procedural man does the procedural thing, in order: the guidance note, the security summary, the diary
Monday 9 Nov, 09:00, nothing in his diary — and the congress is 'a public gathering'
The registry counter: Miriam is the Registrar for the length of the scene ('there are eleven people on this floor')
12:14 — Reader B: DISSENT, sealed at 12:00. His own request declined under a clause he drafted in 2035
14:02 — Reader C concurs. Warrant issues. A very small objection files itself in the back of his head
The phone rings: CASSIM, A. — DEP DIR
chapters.turn: The document that would save him is nine metres below him and lawful to withhold, and the warrant is live

chapters.title: Authorisation
beats: Cassim tells him plainly that she must authorise his uptake, and that she has asked for a delay
She is straight with him; she offers to walk in with him herself
He hears a coup — because she is competent and eleven weeks old (A-05)
The uptake team is being assembled in the same building
chapters.turn: He decides she is behind it. She is not. Nothing in the scene supports him and he is certain

chapters.title: The Mesh He Specified
beats: He runs, and the running is technical: he knows the refresh rates, the blind arcs, the escalation ladder
Case card #1 (an ordinary named person, half a page, never mentioned again) (PP-014)
Every skill that saves him is one he wrote into a manual
chapters.turn: The architect discovers his building is very good

chapters.title: Lombard
chapters.setting: A panel van; a Boksburg yard
beats: Lombard finds him first, because Lombard always finds him first
Twenty-two years; the drive to Beauty Ngobese's funeral in 2027 (PP-006)
Warmth, jokes, first names; a place to sleep
One small wrong note the reader files and Motaung does not
chapters.turn: Bond before the betrayal; the reader is made to like him

chapters.title: Three Rooms
chapters.day: Day Two — Thursday 5 November 2054 (while he sleeps)
chapters.pov: Grace Sithole / Wynand Loots / Karabo Ntuli
chapters.setting: The sealed suites, Struben Street basement
beats: Three shift workers with a headache: a kettle, a lanyard, a chair with a broken height adjustment
Grace's private religion: she has been right every time, because it cannot be checked
Wynand files fewer dissents than he used to; his file records this as improvement (PP-012)
Karabo's hardcover notebook, a disciplinary offence under her contract (PP-009)
chapters.turn: Three people ended eleven thousand lives and are not permitted to know if they were right

chapters.title: Access Log
chapters.setting: A phone call; then the house in Waverley
beats: Miriam's registry access, repeatedly, against Grobler's name (PP-005)
He confronts her badly, in the kitchen, in the register of a man being accurate instead of frightened
She does not explain, because explaining costs eleven years
Thirty-four years and one subject they have never raised
chapters.turn: The second wrong certainty; he leaves sure of the one person who is on his side

chapters.title: From the Other Side
beats: He watches an uptake from the pavement, as a fugitive, on someone else
It is done exactly as he specified: courteous, twenty minutes, a call permitted
The neighbour's face; the child; the packing
He can name every step before it happens and cannot stop one of them
chapters.turn: Mandate #2 paid in full: he sees his own decency from below and it is unbearable

chapters.title: Change Control
chapters.setting: A borrowed terminal in a shuttered municipal office
beats: Looking for the frame, he finds housekeeping instead
A 2049 refresh-schedule change: two lines, signed by a systems manager who has since emigrated (PP-007)
It means nothing to him. He notes it because he notes things
The reader does not know it is a gun
chapters.turn: The book's largest fact goes by as an administrative detail

chapters.title: Indemnity
chapters.setting: A parkade off Steve Biko Road
beats: Four men in good suits and a clipboard
A signed indemnity form, because they are a compliance department
No violence; a bottle of water; a seatbelt fastened for him
chapters.turn: Part One ends with him taken by the wrong people, courteously (A-08)

chapters.title: Shirtsleeves
beats: Grobler in shirtsleeves, unhurried, faintly amused; Afrikaans to relax the room
He buried eleven of his own people in the Brownouts and ran the East Rand competently
No gloating, no monologue; an argument
chapters.turn: The antagonist is a host, and likeable, which is worse

chapters.title: The Case
chapters.setting: The lodge; a table of lever-arch files
beats: Sealed findings are unconstitutional; the numbers; the advocates' opinions
It is correct, and Motaung knows it is correct within four minutes
And 240,000 jobs became 31,000, and Grobler says so without embarrassment (mandate #3)
chapters.turn: The reader's footing goes: the villain's case is the reader's case

chapters.title: How to Farm a Finding
chapters.day: Day Four — Saturday 7 November 2054, after dark
beats: The Federation arranged the proximity: a leaked file, a threat routed to him, a grievance manufactured
Not evidence planted — inputs planted (PP-003)
PRIOR CONTACT: None of record was the truest line in the packet and it convicted him
Case card #2 (PP-014)
chapters.turn: He was farmed; and the finding may still be right

chapters.title: Fourteen Months
chapters.day: RETROSPECT — Day One, Wednesday 4 November, 08:00-09:40 (placed here on purpose)
beats: The man who broke in 2050 and was kept on because recalibration takes four years
He files his first dissent in fourteen months, alone, with a headache, and tells nobody
He does not know whose name it is beyond the name (PP-012)
chapters.turn: The bravest act in the book is performed by the most damaged person in it, in private, and sealed within the hour

chapters.title: What Cassim Did on Wednesday
chapters.setting: The lodge road; a petrol station outside Hartbeespoort
beats: Cassim reaches him — having spent three days filing an urgent application on his behalf
She argued against the Act in 2044 and has never hidden it; that is why the committee wanted her
There was no coup. There was never anything to find (A-05)
chapters.turn: The paranoia had no object; the reader's own suspicion is indicted with his

chapters.title: Four Hundred and Nine
beats: Miriam's ledger: every sealed finding since 2043, copied by hand
She never gave one to anyone. She simply could not stand that nobody was counting
She puts Finding B in his hand (A-10, A-11, PP-005)
chapters.turn: The wife is right first, and has been for eleven years

chapters.title: The Count
chapters.setting: The kitchen; the ledger open between them
beats: What publishing it does: the concurrence test voids, and with it every 2-1 warrant
Eleven thousand residents at Doringkop. She is the only person who has counted them
Both truths on one page, and neither of them arbitrates (A-21)
chapters.turn: The vise closes

chapters.title: The Medical Aid
beats: Lombard says it first, before he is asked, standing badly
A daughter; a medical aid that stopped covering it; a first payment he called a consulting fee
No speech, no sneer; the dignity of a reason (A-12, PP-006)
chapters.turn: He is loyal to Josiah and it is not the same thing, and now it matters

chapters.title: The Recursion
chapters.setting: Suite C; then a corridor she is not permitted to be in
beats: She has felt it for months in her own findings and been forbidden to know
The refresh schedule; the operational record; a distributed finding is an input (PP-007)
There was never a majority. There were three men. All three findings are correct
She writes the Reader's Note (PP-009)
chapters.turn: DETONATION — the concept of a verdict collapses

chapters.title: The Man Who Read It
beats: He works out what Karabo has worked out, from the other end, with the two findings in front of him
Reading the dissent made him the man in the third finding
The self-negating prophecy, closed
chapters.turn: He is no longer arguing about whether the machine is right. He is deciding what to make true

chapters.title: Thirty-Four Years
beats: The subject they have never raised, finally raised
She does not tell him what to do; she tells him what she counted
The last ordinary human page before the machine takes the wheel
chapters.turn: She stops arguing, which is how he knows she has understood him

chapters.title: Doringkop
chapters.setting: The Highveld past Delmas; the fence line
beats: He drives out and stands at a fence whose specification he signed
The soccer field; the second-weekend visitors' gate; the library window
Case card #3 (PP-014); the storm arriving on schedule
chapters.turn: The weighing, wordless. He gets back in the car

chapters.title: Eleven Minutes
beats: Four hundred delegates, three broadcast crews, a lanyard he did not have to forge
Grobler with the sealed finding in his hand and the country's attention
The clock arrives exactly where Finding A said it would on page one (PP-011)
chapters.turn: Everything the book has built is now in one room and there is nothing left to try

chapters.title: The Proof
beats: No speech. He does not explain himself in the room
The reader understands a half-beat before the room that the shot is the only remaining argument
It works (A-15)
chapters.turn: DETONATION — the machine is made true by the man it named

chapters.title: By the Book
chapters.setting: A holding room; the road to Doringkop
beats: No trial: a Director who has fulfilled a finding is the Directorate's best evidence
His own uptake, done exactly as the prologue's was, by people who admire him (PP-002)
The magistrate who has never declined a renewal signs the order (PP-013)
chapters.turn: The courtesy from the prologue comes back for him, and it is a mercy, and it is nothing

chapters.title: Resident
beats: Miriam takes voluntary spousal residence — a regulation someone kind once inserted
The soccer league; the library; the second-weekend gate from the inside
Cassim in the chair; the Directorate does not miss him for a single day (A-17)
chapters.turn: The cruellest fact in the book, delivered flatly, in one line

chapters.title: The Seat
beats: Cassim visits. She has renewed the seal, because she had to (PP-004)
The Ngobese docket changes hands (PP-008)
The plain warning: it will be you, because of where you sit (A-18)
Karabo Ntuli's Reader's Note, quoted once (PP-009)
chapters.turn: Smaller than the idea; no paragraph explains what it means
